comments.body:
Correct English name for this discovery: Sumatran Rhinoceros

Further Research Quest name: Further Research on the Armored Animal
Skill requirement: r12 Ecological Research, r14 Biology, IND(Indian Languages)
Pre-requisite discovery: Indian Rhinoceros discovery (from "Animal with Armour" quest) + Rhinoceros discovery (from "Large horn animal map")
Required Sophia rank: 4
Sophia cost: 400 points
